description: A white chandelier with a spiraling tiered design. The main body of the chandelier is composed of multiple circular frames stacked vertically, creating a layered effect. Attached to these frames are numerous small, oval-shaped decorative elements that appear to be clear or translucent, giving the chandelier a delicate and airy appearance. A braided cord or chain hangs from a ceiling canopy and connects to the top of the chandelier. The overall design is intricate and modern, suggesting it would cast interesting light patterns when illuminated.
